journal.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.title: The Sexton's Tally
journal.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.1:
Tally of Wen, sexton, kept for my own sake.

The master says he fears nothing now. He says his heart is not in his chest any more, and laughs, and I do not like the sound.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.2: Four nights I carried a black urn out from the hatch and he would not let me help. I walked it %s, about %s paces. I came back with dirt to my knees and no urn. He did not say what it was for.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.sexton.3: If you are reading this, do not think it done when he falls. He will stand again in a few days, as well as ever. The urn is the thing. Break the urn.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.hollow.title: A Page in a Black Hand
journal.jaymoskingdoms.hollow.1:
I have put my heart in clay and the clay in the ground, and now let them come with their swords.

A body is a coat. I have had many.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.hollow.2: It lies %s paces down, in a room no bigger than a coffin, with the candles I like. Dig if you must. I am a proud man, and I have marked the place.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.hollow.3: Mossy stones, three of them, and a skull on top, because I could not help myself. Anyone who looks will find it. Few will look.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.crypt_gossip.0: There's an old crypt %s of here, about %s paces. Nobody goes. Nobody who goes comes back easy.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.crypt_gossip.1: The bone-man in the crypt can't be killed, they say. He's put his heart somewhere else. Kill him and he's back in a few days.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.crypt_gossip.2: My gran said the bone-man hid his heart %s of his crypt, under a pile of mossy stones with a skull on top. She wouldn't go and look.
